answer:
Meta lists failure of the strategy as a standalone risk. It says it may not be successful in its Reality Labs strategy and investments, which could adversely affect its business, reputation, or financial results. It adds that the strategy may not succeed in the foreseeable future, or at all. Meta warns that the metaverse may not develop in accordance with its expectations and that market acceptance of the features, products, or services it builds is uncertain. It also says it has relatively limited experience with consumer hardware products and virtual and augmented reality technology, which may enable other companies to compete more effectively than Meta. Meta says its RL efforts may divert resources and management attention from other areas of its business. Meta states that its ability to support RL investments depends on generating sufficient profits from other areas of its business. It describes RL as a complex, evolving, long-term initiative. It also says many RL investments target long-term research and development for products that may only be fully realized in the next decade. Meta says RL investments reduced its 2025 overall operating profit by approximately $19.19 billion, and it expects 2026 RL operating losses to remain similar to 2025. It says that if the investments are not successful longer-term, its business and financial performance will be harmed. In the six months ended June 30, 2026, RL reduced operating profit by approximately $8.65 billion. The RL segment's operating loss was $(16,120) million in 2023, $(17,729) million in 2024 and $(19,193) million in 2025. The 2025 loss rose $1.46 billion, or 8%, from 2024. Meta attributed the increase to higher employee compensation, estimated losses on non-cancelable purchase commitments for RL inventory, and technology development costs. Meta's FY2023 operating margin was about 34.66% (operating income $46.751 billion on revenue $134.902 billion). Meta's FY2024 operating margin was about 42.18% (operating income $69.38 billion on revenue $164.501 billion).
